build.description: Run npm run build, merge kob-dev to master, push, then switch back to kob-dev
build.prompt:
Run these steps in order:
1. Commit all uncommitted changes on current branch with a descriptive message
2. Run `npm run build` to bump version, compile binary, publish to npm, and push tags
3. Checkout master, merge kob-dev, push master
4. Checkout back to kob-dev
5. Report the new version number and confirm success
